units.source_text: 温暖和煦的阳光洒在关着的拉窗上，老梅树枝错落有致的影子映在一排窗纸上，

en.t: Warm, gentle sunlight fell on the closed sliding screens, and the artfully scattered shadows of an old plum tree's branches were cast across a row of paper window panels,

units.source_text: 窗户由右到左延伸开来，约莫有两三丈长。

en.t: The windows stretched from right to left and were roughly two or three jo long.

units.source_text: 浅野内匠头的家臣大石内蔵助良雄原，那时候正交由细川家监管。

en.t: Oishi Kuranosuke Yoshio, a retainer of Asano Takumi-no-kami, was at that time being held under the supervision of the Hosokawa family.

units.source_text: 他靠拉窗而坐，双膝并拢，正襟危坐，从刚才开始就在认真的看书。

en.t: He sat leaning against the sliding screen, knees together and posture formal, and had been reading intently for some time.

units.source_text: 一本约莫是细川家某位家臣借给他的书——《三国志》中的一本。

en.t: It was probably a book lent to him by one of the Hosokawa family's retainers, a volume of The Three Kingdoms.
